CTI-Bench: Reverse Cyber Mapping (RCM) (2021)
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains 1,000 examples for reverse cyber mapping tasks. It evaluates a model's ability to work backwards from observed indicators or effects to identify the underlying attack techniques, tools, or threat actors.
